methodologyNotes: Self-serve USD pricing fetched from each vendor's official pricing page on 2026-06-15 via WebFetch. Plausible's pricing page is fully JS-rendered and returned locked-dashboard HTML on every attempt; prices confirmed from multiple secondary pages (wordpress-analytics-plugin page stated '$9/month', homepage stated Starter=$9, Growth=$14, Business=$19 for 10k PV base) and corroborated by kinsta.com blog ($9/month starting price, May 2024). Pirsch pricing was captured from the first successful fetch of pirsch.io/pricing (Standard $6/mo, Plus $12/mo); the page subsequently returned 404 on retries, so alternativeto.net was used for corroboration (range $5–$799/mo confirmed). Matomo Cloud is priced in EUR only (€29/mo starter); USD equivalent ~$31.60 at 1.09 EUR/USD is noted but monthlyUsd records the published EUR-converted approximation with a caveat in notes. Cloudflare Web Analytics is free standalone. GA4 360 is contact-sales only. All minutesIncluded / callsIncluded / overagePerMin / overagePerCall fields are null (non-telephony vertical). Annual discount of ~17% ('2 months free') is consistent across Plausible, Fathom, Matomo, and Simple Analytics. accessedAt='2026-06-15' on all source records.

vendors.name: Google Analytics 4
vendors.provenance: https://marketingplatform.google.com/about/analytics/ accessed 2026-06-15; GA4 360 enterprise tier confirmed contact-sales only

plans.name: Google Analytics 4 (Free)
plans.notes: Free forever. Up to 10M events/month per property, 500 distinct events, standard reports, BigQuery export (free tier), up to 2 years data retention. No HIPAA compliance on free tier.

plans.name: Google Analytics 360
plans.notes: Contact sales / quote-only. Enterprise tier with higher event limits (25B events/month), unsampled reports, advanced attribution, SLA, dedicated support. Historically priced at ~$150k/year but Google does not publish current rates.

vendors.name: Plausible Analytics
vendors.provenance: https://plausible.io/ (homepage) accessed 2026-06-15; pricing JS-rendered, plan names/base prices confirmed from multiple plausible.io sub-pages; corroborated by kinsta.com/blog/plausible-analytics/ (May 2024). Official page states 'Plans start at $9/month based on page views' and homepage shows Starter=$9, Growth=$14, Business=$19 for 10k PV entry tier with '2 months free' annual billing.

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: Entry tier at 10k pageviews/month. 1 site, solo use, no team sharing. 3-year data retention. Email/Slack reports, GA import, goals, segments. Price scales with pageview volume (slider-based). Annual billing saves ~2 months (~17% off). 30-day free trial, no credit card.

plans.name: Growth
plans.notes: Entry tier at 10k pageviews/month; scales with traffic. Up to 3 sites, 3 team members. Team management, shared links, embedded dashboards. 3-year data retention. Annual billing saves ~2 months (~17%).

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: Entry tier at 10k pageviews/month; scales with traffic. Up to 10 sites, 10 team members. 5-year data retention. Custom properties, Stats API, Looker Studio connector, ecommerce revenue tracking, funnels. Annual billing saves ~2 months (~17%).

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Contact sales / quote-only. 10+ sites, 600+ API requests/hour, SSO, managed proxy, raw data exports, priority support. Custom pageview limits.

vendors.name: Fathom Analytics
vendors.provenance: https://usefathom.com/pricing accessed 2026-06-15; full pricing table fetched successfully including all pageview tiers from 100k to 25M+.

plans.name: 100k pageviews/mo
plans.notes: Up to 100k pageviews/month. Up to 50 sites. Includes ecommerce/event tracking, API access, forever data retention, unlimited email reports and data exports. Annual plan: $150/year (~$12.50/mo effective). 7-day free trial.

plans.name: 200k pageviews/mo
plans.notes: Up to 200k pageviews/month. All features included. Annual plan: $250/year (~$20.83/mo effective). Same feature set as all other tiers.

plans.name: 500k pageviews/mo
plans.notes: Up to 500k pageviews/month. Annual: $450/year.

plans.name: 1M pageviews/mo
plans.notes: Up to 1M pageviews/month. Annual: $600/year.

plans.name: 2M pageviews/mo
plans.notes: Up to 2M pageviews/month. Annual: $1,000/year.

plans.name: 5M pageviews/mo
plans.notes: Up to 5M pageviews/month. Annual: $1,400/year.

plans.name: 10M pageviews/mo
plans.notes: Up to 10M pageviews/month. Annual: $2,000/year.

plans.name: Over 25M pageviews/mo
plans.notes: Contact support for custom pricing above 25M pageviews/month.

vendors.name: Matomo
vendors.provenance: https://matomo.org/pricing/ accessed 2026-06-15. Cloud plans priced in EUR only; USD approximate at 1.09 EUR/USD noted in plan notes. HIPAA available on-premise only (Matomo Cloud is not HIPAA compliant per matomo.org/matomo-analytics-hipaa-compliance/). hipaa=true reflects on-premise capability; baa=false because Matomo explicitly states no BAA is needed/offered.

plans.name: On-Premise Community
plans.notes: Free open-source self-hosted edition. Unlimited websites, unlimited users, unlimited hits. Community forum support only. HIPAA-capable when self-hosted on compliant infrastructure.

plans.name: Cloud Starter
plans.notes: Priced at €29/month (ex tax) — Matomo Cloud is billed in EUR only and does not publish a USD price, so monthlyUsd is null (USD equivalent is ~$32 at ~1.09 EUR/USD but that is a derived approximation, not a confirmable published figure). 50,000 hits/month. Annual billing gives 2 months free (~17% discount). Unlimited websites. Hosted in Frankfurt, Germany. Cloud is NOT HIPAA compliant. 21-day free trial, no credit card. Verified at matomo.org/pricing 2026-06-15 (€29/mo, '2 months free' annual).

plans.name: Cloud Business
plans.notes: Contact sales / quote-only. Higher hit limits (100k–600k+ hits/month). Custom pricing for larger traffic volumes.

plans.name: Cloud Enterprise
plans.notes: Contact sales / quote-only. 1M+ hits/month, dedicated infrastructure, SLA, advanced support.

vendors.name: Simple Analytics
vendors.provenance: https://www.simpleanalytics.com/pricing accessed 2026-06-15 (via redirect from simpleanalytics.com/pricing); confirmed plan structure: free forever, $20/mo self-serve (slider up to 2.5M PV), Enterprise custom.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Free forever with privacy-preserving badge required. Unlimited pageviews (fair use). 30-day data history. 1 user, 5 websites. 14-day full-feature trial included.

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: Self-serve $20/month. Traffic-based slider from 100k to 2.5M pageviews/month. 1 included user; +$20/month per additional user (per-seat add-on). Annual billing: 2 months free (~17% off; effective ~$16.67/mo). 14-day free trial.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Contact sales / quote-only. Custom traffic limits, SOC 2, SSO/SAML, role-based access, priority support, manual invoicing available (min $500 invoice).

vendors.name: Pirsch Analytics
vendors.provenance: https://pirsch.io/pricing accessed 2026-06-15 (first fetch succeeded; subsequent fetches returned 404 suggesting rate-limiting/JS gate). Standard=$6/mo for 10k PV (50 sites), Plus=$12/mo (unlimited sites). Corroborated by alternativeto.net listing range '$5–$799/mo'.

plans.name: Standard
plans.notes: Starting at $6/month for 10,000 monthly pageviews. Up to 50 websites. Annual billing available with savings (exact % not published on pricing page). Payment: credit card, PayPal, SEPA direct debit (EUR). Prices ex applicable sales taxes. 30-day free trial (or 100k pageviews, whichever first), no credit card.

plans.name: Plus
plans.notes: Best value tier at $12/month. Unlimited websites. Custom domains, white-label dashboard, advanced features. Annual billing available with savings. Price scales with pageview volume.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Contact sales / quote-only. Custom pageview limits, dedicated infrastructure, SLA, on-premise/self-hosted license options. Price depends on size and needs.

vendors.name: Cloudflare Web Analytics
vendors.provenance: https://www.cloudflare.com/web-analytics/ accessed 2026-06-15; page states 'essential web analytics to everyone with a website without compromising user privacy. For free.' Cloudflare plan pricing confirmed from https://cloudflare.com/plans/ (Free $0, Pro $25/mo, Business $250/mo, Enterprise custom).

plans.name: Free (All Plans)
plans.notes: Cloudflare Web Analytics is free and included with all Cloudflare plans including the free tier. No pageview limits published. Privacy-first, cookieless, no personal data collection. Works on any website (not just those proxied through Cloudflare). Core Web Vitals, referrer, country, device, page views, visitors.
